I kept my fingers crossed as with time the photos had gone bad and every time, I looked at them I felt a guilty. Jayesh was patient with me as I kept on asking for changes until, I was satisfied. In less than a week he created magic, especially in my aunt’s case, he worked on a passport size old pic and gave me a photo of 6x8 inches nicely framed.
If you find yourself in a similar situation like mine. Don’t hesitate meet Jayesh @ Studio Art, I am sure he will resurrect your old photographs (memories). Jayesh bhai you rock!!!

We recently got a photoshoot done for our 15-month-old baby girl at Digitech Colour Lab Photo Studio, and the experience was truly wonderful. The entire shoot was completed in around 1.5 hours, and the team handled our baby with a lot of care, patience, and professionalism.
